stages.name: Code gate and anti-loop control
stages.goal: Stop false progress from repeated state-only updates and force code-backed outcomes.

stages.name: Patch executor
stages.goal: Move from package planning to explicit file patch application in .py/.ps1 modules.

stages.name: Validation and rollback intelligence
stages.goal: Add smarter tests, endpoint checks, rollback triggers, and fault isolation.

stages.name: Dependency-aware implementation
stages.goal: Change modules in the right order based on dependency graphs.

stages.name: Specialized agent mesh
stages.goal: Grow stable specialist roles for code, testing, architecture, observability, and integrations.

stages.name: Autonomous roadmap execution
stages.goal: Execute long project directions with checkpoints and measurable progress.
